message:
Let me check if there are existing test DWARF files I can use as a base, and also check if the library is already built:

<｜｜DSML｜｜
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libdwarf && find . -name "*.o" -o -name "*.a" -o -name "*.so" 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; find . -name "*.elf" -o -name "*.o" -path "*test*" 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "---"; ls test/*.o 2>/dev/null | head</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
